review_scope: Russian copy consistency across Web and Flutter readiness and topology states
Long audio device labels and access to full values
Audit timestamp, status and technical identifier readability
Mobile role warning visibility above persistent save controls
Reduced-motion behavior, layout stability, contrast and source/after screenshots

source_after_comparisons.review: The recommended 1080p/30 FPS profile is visible, advanced controls are collapsed behind a named disclosure, the selected value is summarized, and Start remains reachable after scrolling the modal body. Progressive disclosure is intentional.
Source-sized mobile capture keeps the recommendation and primary setup action clear; advanced settings remain available on demand.

Known readiness reasons use contextual Russian text; unknown backend enums are not exposed. Wrapped status badges stay within the layout. Runtime values differ because this disposable fixture has no SFU or object storage.

Selected role and permission states remain explicit. Account and permission fixture values are synthetic. A separate 393x852 production-component regression confirms the long warning scrolls fully above the fixed save actions and passes axe.

Long hardware names may be clipped in the closed native select, but the complete option remains available; Web exposes the selected full label in title and Flutter exposes it through tooltip and semantics. Device IDs remain hidden. After labels come from the host browser.

Events are grouped by local date with visible HH:MM; details provide the full localized timestamp and event type. Long Web detail values wrap instead of clipping; Flutter expansion details retain the full event type and localized timestamp. Synthetic account names differ from the reference data.

readiness_copy.details: Web/Flutter map database_unavailable, sfu_unavailable, statfs_unavailable, invalid_measurement, insufficient_space, busy and timeout to Russian contextual copy; unknown and blank codes are suppressed. Status and storage metric labels are aligned.

layout_shift.assertion: Readiness dependency-card Y position changes by no more than 1 CSS pixel from ready to refreshing and after a 503 response.

audio_device_labels.details: Web native select preserves the full option and selected-label title; Flutter control ellipsizes visually while tooltip and semantics expose the complete label.

mobile_role_warning.details: The warning can be scrolled wholly above persistent save controls; the production component passes axe.

audit_readability.details: Web summary exposes HH:MM and expanded details expose full localized time and event type; responsive detail values wrap. Flutter exposes full event type and localized time in the expanded row.

reduced_motion.evidence: 47-case Web accessibility browser run includes reduced-motion transition and scroll assertions; Flutter audit expansion honors MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf.

contrast.limitation: Sampled semantic token pairs; not a whole-application contrast certification.

icon_and_action_semantics.details: No new icon-only action was introduced in this polish slice. Reviewed actions retain their labels and selected, disabled, busy and destructive treatments; no unsupported icon behavior was observed in the six reference flows.

artifact_handling: Source and after PNGs are ignored local .out captures. This tracked manifest records paths, dimensions and SHA-256 values; screenshot binaries are not staged.
release_limitation: This issue's copy and visual-polish scope is reviewed. Physical device and spoken screen-reader acceptance remain separate open gates under #301 and #303.
